format_variation: numbered mixed pump/cable with historical reference
expected_behavior: The borewell pump is supported, while the historical cable edition and other components may remain unresolved. Do not silently cover those gaps; REVIEW is the safe result.
source_text_for_pdf:
1) Supply a 4 HP borewell submersible pump set for a 125 mm farm well, 415 V three phase, 60 m head and 3.5 L/s discharge.
2) Include 30 m of flat, three-core PVC insulated submersible cable rated 1100 V; the schedule cites IS 694:1990.
3) Include starter panel, protection relay and delivery column.
4) Conduct pump performance testing and hand over the test record.
5) Provide installation, warranty and operator instructions.
